import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;

        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Triple {
        int first, second, third;

        Triple(int first, int second, int third) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
            this.third = third;
        }
    }

    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> G;
    static List<Edge> e;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        G.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        G.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                int id = G.get(u).get(i);
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink)
                        return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long sendFlow(int u, long flow) {
        if (flow == 0)
            return 0;
        if (u == sink)
            return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < G.get(u).size(); ptr[u]++) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.get(id).v;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1)
                continue;
            long pushed = sendFlow(v, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).capacity - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinics() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (findPath()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (long pushed = sendFlow(source, Long.MAX_VALUE))
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static boolean[][][] isReachable = new boolean[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visited = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] becomesUnusableAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;
    static boolean isValid(int r, int c) {
        if (r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m)
            return true;
        return false;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[0]);
        m = n;
        sink = m * m + m * m + 1;
        source = 0;
        G = new ArrayList<>(m * m * 2 + 2);
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; i++)
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        Queue<Pair> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            scientists[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            reactors[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    Q.add(new Pair(i, j));
                    becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = Q.poll();
            int x = p.first, y = p.second;
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++)
                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + i, ny = y + j;
                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] = becomesUnusableAt[x][y] + 1;
                            Q.add(new Pair(nx, ny));
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (scientists[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && scientists[x].charAt(y) <= '9')
                    addEdge(source, getID(x, y), scientists[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                if (reactors[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && reactors[x].charAt(y) <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, reactors[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z')
                            continue;
                        boolean[][] visited2 = new boolean[n][m];
                        Queue<Triple> Q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                        Q2.add(new Triple(x, y, 1));
                        visited2[x][y] = true;
                        while (!Q2.isEmpty()) {
                            Triple t = Q2.poll();
                            int x2 = t.first, y2 = t.second, tim = t.third;
                            if (x2 == X && y2 == Y) {
                                visited2[x2][y2] = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= becomesUnusableAt[x2][y2] || tim >= T)
                                continue;
                            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++)
                                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                                        int nx2 = x2 + i, ny2 = y2 + j;
                                        if (isValid(nx2, ny2) && !visited2[nx2][ny2] && scientists[nx2].charAt(ny2) != 'Y' && scientists[nx2].charAt(ny2) != 'Z' && tim + 1 <= becomesUnusableAt[nx2][ny2]) {
                                            visited2[nx2][ny2] = true;
                                            Q2.add(new Triple(nx2, ny2, tim + 1));
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                        }
                        if (visited2[X][Y]) {
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = (int) dinics();
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
